title: Provider profile (~/.code-copilot-team/providers.toml)
description: The peer-review and evaluator providers available on this machine, their default pairings, and the copyright name for generated files. Expressed as JSON Schema over the TOML document's structure: the readers are shell (scripts/review-round-runner.sh's toml_get, scripts/auto-build-loop.sh, adapters/claude-code/setup.sh), so this file is the contract of record and scripts/validate-providers-profile.sh enforces it. Only keys some reader actually consults appear here; the file holds the NAME of a key's environment variable, never the key itself.

copyright.description: Written by setup.sh; read when a generated source file needs a copyright header.

company.description: Company name stamped into the copyright header of generated source files. Empty until setup.sh prompts for it on an interactive install.

defaults.description: Subject-to-peer pairings. A subject is the provider whose work is reviewed. TOML parses `peer_for.claude = "x"` into a nested table, so these are objects keyed by subject name.

peer_for.description: Subject name to the provider that reviews it when --peer-review names none. Every value must be a declared provider.

fallback_chain.description: Subject name to the providers tried in order when the peer fails its healthcheck, or (since #190 D1) ran and produced no review. Never consulted after a verdict.

providers.description: One entry per provider; the table name is the provider's id.

provider_type.description: Dispatch topology. 'openai-compatible' and 'ollama' are served by scripts/provider-adapters/; 'cli' and 'custom' run the command template.

command.description: Command template for cli/custom providers. {review_request} is replaced with the request file's path and {model} with the model name. Send the tool's own chatter to stderr or /dev/null: stdout is parsed.

conformance_command.description: Command template for a runtime conformance evaluator (auto-build). Must carry the {review_request} placeholder.

healthcheck.description: Command that exits 0 when the provider is reachable. Quoting note: the profile parser keeps TOML escapes literally, so pass a bearer token with `curl --oauth2-bearer $VAR`, not an escaped -H header.

model.description: Model name sent with the request, or substituted into {model}.

base_url.description: API base for openai-compatible providers, including the version path (…/v1).

api_key_env.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the key. Never the key. Export it where non-interactive shells see it (~/.zshenv).

max_tokens.description: Response token budget (default 4096). A reasoning model needs headroom beyond its hidden reasoning, or disable_thinking.

disable_thinking.description: Turn the model's hidden reasoning off. Sends BOTH chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false (vLLM) and thinking.type=disabled (DeepSeek); a server that rejects one with a 400 is asked again without it. Compared exactly, so the value must be bare `true` with no trailing comment.

price_usd_per_mtok_input.description: Peak, cache-miss input rate per million tokens. Set both rates to make the provider metered; the ledger then debits measured cost instead of the run's per-invocation estimate.

price_usd_per_mtok_output.description: Peak, cache-miss output rate per million tokens.

version.description: Free-text note about the server or CLI build; recorded with the provider fingerprint.
